name: moose-tracker
description: Moose Tracker is a retro synthesizer and music tracker. Your assistant writes sound effects and songs as notes; Moose Tracker's own synthesizer and drum kits play them. Get WAV sound effects, Ogg Vorbis or WAV songs (with seamless loop points), or a link that plays the song in your browser. No sign-in; we do not keep your song text.
